scope: Deep-history storage/RSS characterization and native diagnostic accounting optimization; no eviction, undo cap, renderer changes or claimed process-memory saving.

before.note: Single sequential warm run on generated stereo 44.1kHz WAVs; seven repeated diagnostics calls per checkpoint. RSS includes native mappings and allocator retention, not WebKit. Storage counters exclude piece-vector/marker metadata and temporary workers. No user files or audio device.

after.note: Single sequential warm run on generated stereo 44.1kHz WAVs; seven repeated diagnostics calls per checkpoint. RSS includes native mappings and allocator retention, not WebKit. Storage counters exclude piece-vector/marker metadata and temporary workers. No user files or audio device.

before.note: One cold inventory after each 100 loop edits, on 100 local edits of a generated stereo 30s WAV. This measures cache misses during metadata changes, not repeated idle polling.

after.note: One cold inventory after each 100 loop edits, on 100 local edits of a generated stereo 30s WAV. This measures cache misses during metadata changes, not repeated idle polling.

limits: Single sequential native test-process runs on generated files; no WebKit, real audio device, user database or user audio.
Seven warm repetitions per history checkpoint, not a production latency distribution. First inventory after a distinct audio edit still walks history.
RSS includes mapped pages and allocator retention; PCM/cache counters are not disjoint from RSS and exclude snapshot/vector metadata and temporary workers.
Full-file edit history retains separate data and peak caches intentionally; no global cache-memory bound is introduced by this change.
